newsitem.title: SPAIN: Spain's Vitoria June cargo traffic rises 35.3 pct.
newsitem.headline: Spain's Vitoria June cargo traffic rises 35.3 pct.

text.p: Cargo traffic at Vitoria airport rose 35.3 percent in June, compared with the same month last year, to 2,052 tonnes, the airport authority said.
This follows a 4.5 percent increase in May and takes the total so far this year to 13,294 tonnes, a 21.9 percent increase on 1996.
International non-European Union (EU) freight accounted for 877 tonnes of the June total, EU freight for 743 tonnes and domestic cargo only 433 tonnes.
Vitoria started commercial cargo operations in 1994 and showed monthly growth rates of as much as 150 percent in 1996. - Reuters Air Cargo Service Tel+ 44 171 542 7706 Fax +5017 - www.racs.com
